Measurable separator cell: wins+losses >= 25 and each side >= 10; scratch = |points| < instrument median spread, excluded from labels. Exit-efficiency pools variants — the same fire appears under each management, so rows are management-outcomes, not independent fires (stated). Prices are the FUTURES leg (the journal's basis). FILL MODEL: PESSIMISTIC (inherited). ° = dimmed (below measurability), excluded from the arithmetic. NET LEDGER = per-cell pooled net with MANDATORY zone decomposition (descriptive, no null; ranking is best-of-field by construction): pooled INCLUDES the lockbox span under the dated operator order of 2026-08-27 — the one sanctioned decomposition display; register 85 stands for every evidential aggregate, and the decomposition columns are why the pooled number is candidate-generation only. NO CELL IS QUOTABLE FROM THE LEDGER WITHOUT ITS FORWARD COLUMN. EXCLUDED FROM AGGREGATES: 3370 lockbox-span rows, 0 sealed rows (of 22994 journal rows; 19624 used).
